game_integration.three_js_loader: const loader = new GLTFLoader(); loader.load('unit_test_soldier.glb', (gltf) => scene.add(gltf.scene));
game_integration.unity_guidance: Drag unit_test_soldier.fbx or unit_test_soldier.glb directly into your Assets/Skins/ folder. Ensure Rig is set to Humanoid or Generic.
game_integration.unreal_guidance: Import unit_test_soldier.fbx with 'Import Skeletal Mesh' and 'Import Animations' checked.
